svg.title: rPod wiring: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W to the 2-inch display and the click wheel
svg.text: rPod wiring: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W
Waveshare 2″ ST7789V display and 4th-gen iPod click wheel · top view, component side up · parts not to scale
pins as numbered on the ribbon
GPIO 18 is the I²S DAC's clock.
3.3 V part: never wire it to 5 V.
CLOCK and DATA use the Pi's
Pin map: docs/PLAN.md §1.2 · boot config: system/config.txt.d/rpod.txt · any 3V3 or GND header pin works for power
